numbers.title: Numbers & access
numbers.description: Name each WhatsApp number, choose the default, and decide who works which number.
numbers.howShared: A number with nobody allocated is shared: it works exactly as before, and agents see only the chats they own or are assigned.
numbers.howAllocated: Allocate people to a number and they can send from it, and their new chats start from it. They still see only their own and assigned chats (team leaders also their team's).
numbers.howAdmins: Admins and owners always see every chat on every number.
numbers.emptyBody: Connect a Whapi channel to start. You can add more numbers and allocate each one to different people.
numbers.sharedBody: No one is allocated — every member can start chats from this number.
numbers.teamsEmptyShared: Its teams have nobody in them yet, so it is still shared with everyone.
numbers.accessDesc: The people you tick, and everyone in the teams you tick (leaders included), can send from this number, and their new chats start from it. They still see only their own and assigned chats (team leaders also their team's). Joining or leaving a ticked team gives or takes away the number automatically. Tick nobody to share it with everyone.
numbers.teamsUnavailable: The team list couldn't be loaded, so team access is left as it is. Reload the page to change it.
numbers.draftShared: Nobody selected — this number will be shared with everyone.
numbers.draftTeamsEmptyShared: The selected teams have nobody in them yet — this number stays shared with everyone until they have members.
numbers.draftTeamsEmpty: The selected teams have nobody in them yet, so they add nobody until they have members.
numbers.addDesc: Each Whapi channel is its own WhatsApp number. Create the channel at panel.whapi.cloud, scan its QR code with the phone, then paste its token here.
numbers.channelIdHint: Shown on the channel page. Leave blank and it is learned from the first incoming message.
numbers.addAfterHint: After connecting, use Manage access to decide who works this number.
numbers.addedNoWebhook: Number saved, but incoming messages are not wired yet: {error}
numbers.removeBody: Messages stop sending and arriving on this number. Chat history is kept, and its access list is removed. You can reconnect it later with the same token.
numbers.inboundMissing: Incoming messages aren't set up for this number yet: it can send, but nothing customers write will arrive.
numbers.notLive: This number is not connected right now.
numbers.membersUnavailable: The member list couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to manage access.
numbers.removeBodyMeta: Messages stop sending and arriving on this Meta number, and any task routed to it falls back to your default number. Chat history is kept, and its access list is removed. You can reconnect it later in the WhatsApp section.

apiKeys.createOneHint: Click <bold>New API key</bold> to create one.
apiKeys.scopesHint: A key with no scopes can still call GET /api/v1/me to verify it works.

apiKeys.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually

deals.description: The currency used for new deals and for pipeline and dashboard totals.
deals.defaultCurrencyDesc: New deals default to this currency, and pipeline and dashboard totals are shown in it. Existing deals keep the currency they were saved with.

aiConfig.description: Bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic key. Taamul Connect calls the provider directly with your key — no per-seat AI fees, and your data stays yours. This powers AI-drafted replies in the inbox, the auto-reply bot, and the Playground.
aiConfig.adminOnlyConfig: Only admins and owners can change the AI configuration.
aiConfig.encryptionNotice: Your key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again after saving.
aiConfig.embeddingsHint: An OpenAI key used only to embed your knowledge base (text-embedding-3-small){sameKeyText}. Leave blank to use keyword search instead. Use Remove key to turn semantic search off.
aiConfig.sameKeyText: — can be the same key as above
aiConfig.removeEmbeddingsKeyBody: Semantic search turns off until you add one again.
aiConfig.embeddingsKeyRemoved: The key is removed when you save.
aiConfig.behaviourDesc: Tell the assistant about your business — products, tone, what it may and may not promise. This context feeds both drafts and auto-replies.
aiConfig.promptPlaceholder: e.g. We are Acme, a coffee-equipment store. Be warm and concise. Never quote prices or delivery dates — hand off to a human for those.
aiConfig.enableAssistantDesc: Master switch. Turns on the “Draft with AI” button in the inbox.
aiConfig.autoReplyDesc: The bot answers new inbound messages automatically (only when no flow handles them and no agent is assigned). Hands off to a human when it can’t help.
aiConfig.maxAutoRepliesDesc: After this many bot replies in one thread, the bot goes quiet.
aiConfig.handoffToDesc: When the bot can’t help — or hits the reply cap — it pauses and routes the chat here, with a short note on what happened.
aiConfig.handoffQueue: Unassigned queue (any agent can pick it up)
aiConfig.invalidThreshold: The retrieval threshold must be a number between 0 and 1.
aiConfig.escalationKeywordsDesc: One per line, any language. A customer message containing one of these skips the bot entirely — refund, complaint, legal, manager… Add a trailing * to match word beginnings (refund* matches refunded, refunding).
aiConfig.escalationKeywordsPlaceholder:
refund*
complain*
legal
speak to a manager
شكوى
aiConfig.retrievalThresholdDesc: Minimum similarity (0–1) the best knowledge-base match must reach, otherwise the bot hands off and logs the question below. Needs an embeddings key and documents; 0.4 is a sensible start. Leave empty to turn off.
aiConfig.strictGroundingDesc: The knowledge base is the bot's only source of facts. It may greet and clarify, but never states a price, timeline, or policy it cannot quote.
aiConfig.handoffMessageDesc: Sent to the customer when a gate hands off (keyword, no knowledge match, or a provider error), so they are not left waiting in silence. Leave empty to say nothing.
aiConfig.handoffMessagePlaceholder: Thanks for reaching out — I want to make sure you get the right answer, so a specialist from our team will contact you shortly.
aiConfig.campaignOnlyDesc: Only answer customers who are replying to a broadcast. Every other chat is left to the team.
aiConfig.modelRouting: Route each message to the right model
aiConfig.modelRoutingDesc: TypeSafe Jev judges each message and picks the smallest model that can answer it well; without TypeSafe a simple rule decides. Small-model drafts that ask for a person are retried on the standard model first.
aiConfig.handoverDesc: When a person steps into a chat, and when the AI gets it back.
aiConfig.pauseOnAgentReply: Pause the AI when a person replies in a chat
aiConfig.pauseOnAgentReplyDesc: A reply from anyone on the team stops the bot in that chat, so it never talks over a person.
aiConfig.autoResume: Give the chat back to the AI after
aiConfig.autoResumeDesc: Counted from the last reply a person sent. Never leaves the chat with the team.
aiConfig.guardrailRetry: Rewrite a held draft once before a person reviews it
aiConfig.guardrailRetryDesc: When the AI safety check holds a draft, the large model rewrites it once using the check's reasons. If that is held too, the chat goes to a person with the draft ready to send, edit or discard.

aiKnowledge.title: Knowledge base
aiKnowledge.description: Add FAQs, policies, or product details. The assistant retrieves the relevant pieces when drafting and auto-replying, so it can answer instead of handing off.{searchType}
aiKnowledge.semanticSearchOn: Semantic search is on (embeddings key set).
aiKnowledge.keywordSearchOn: Using keyword search — add an embeddings key above for semantic search.
aiKnowledge.editDocContentPlaceholder: Paste the FAQ answer, policy text, or product details…
aiKnowledge.reindexTooltip: Re-embed all documents (e.g. after adding an embeddings key)
aiKnowledge.uploadTooltip: PDF, .txt, .md, .csv or .json — the text is extracted and added as a document

aiKnowledgeGaps.title: Unanswered questions
aiKnowledgeGaps.description: Customer questions the retrieval threshold refused to answer — nothing in the knowledge base was close enough. Add a document that covers each one, then dismiss it.
aiKnowledgeGaps.empty: Nothing logged. Either every question found a match, or the retrieval threshold is off.

teams.description: Group people into teams, appoint a leader, and allocate WhatsApp numbers to a whole team at once.

teams.noNumbersAllocated: No numbers are allocated to this team.

status.accountNotAllowed: This account is not on the server's allow-list (TS_ACCOUNT_IDS), so the checks can't run here.
status.checkUnavailable: {check} is turned off on this server.

controls.title: Controls
controls.description: Changes save as soon as you make them.
controls.enableDesc: Off: nothing is sent to TypeSafe and the assistant behaves exactly as before.
controls.monitor: Monitor only — log decisions, change nothing
controls.monitorDesc: Every decision is recorded below while the assistant carries on as it does today. Start here.
controls.liveDesc: Threads can be handed to people, replies held or blocked, and customers who opt out marked as opted out.
controls.triageDesc: Hand off requests for a person, complaints and opt-outs.
controls.guardrailDesc: Screen every bot reply: promises of approval, figures not in your sources, non-partner banks, requests for OTP/PIN, other customers' details.
controls.passagesDesc: Drop irrelevant or manipulated knowledge-base excerpts before the bot answers.
controls.watchDesc: Detect opt-outs there too and mark the customer as opted out.

how.title: How we count
how.newChat: A new chat is the first message to someone after 24 hours with no messages either way. Answering a customer who wrote last is a reply, not a new chat.
how.replied: A new chat counts as answered when the customer writes back. Chats from the last 24 hours don't count yet – the customer still has time. We judge replies only after 5 or more chats.
how.tenMinutes: When someone keeps messaging a person who doesn't answer, messages sent within 10 minutes of each other count as one. More than {max} in a row is flagged.
how.limits: Daily limits: {perPerson} new chats per person, {perNumber} per phone number. A new phone number gets up to {warm} a day for its first two weeks.
how.official: Official WhatsApp numbers have no daily new-chat limit; WhatsApp checks them itself.
how.hours: Working hours are {from}–{to}. New chats outside them count as night messages.

how.timezone: Days and "today" follow the {timezone} time zone.
how.phone: Messages typed on the phone itself, outside this app, are not counted here, but WhatsApp still sees them.

timezone.invalid: Use a named time zone, e.g. Asia/Dubai.

notify.label: Bell alerts
notify.help: Tell owners, admins, the team leader and the person when someone reaches their daily limit, or a number reaches its own. Once a day each.

block.label: Stop new chats at the limit
block.help: Don't send a person's message to someone new on a phone number once they, or the number, reach today's limit. Replies always go out; owners and admins are never stopped.

reply_rate_low.title: Few people write back
reply_rate_low.body: Only {replied} of {total} people {name} messaged first wrote back. Message only people who expect you, and say who you are in the first line.

reply_rate_close.title: Replies close to the minimum
reply_rate_close.body: Replies are only just above the minimum ({rate}%, minimum {min}%). Slow down on new chats.

over_limit_today.title: Daily limit reached
over_limit_today.body: {name} has messaged {count} new people today (limit {limit}). No more new chats today — answer the open ones.

over_limit_days.title: Went over the limit before
over_limit_days.body: Went over the daily limit of {limit} on {days, plural, =1 {# day} other {# days}}. Spread new chats across the week.

burst.title: Too many at once
burst.body: Messaged {count} new people within 10 minutes. Wait a minute or two between new chats.

chase_new.title: Keeps messaging people who don't answer
chase_new.body: Kept messaging {count, plural, =1 {# new person} other {# new people}} who never answered. After {limit} messages with no answer, stop.

chase_existing.title: Too many messages without an answer
chase_existing.body: Sent several messages in a row to {count, plural, =1 {# customer} other {# customers}} who haven't answered yet. Give them time.

links_first.title: Links in first messages
links_first.body: Sent a link in the very first message to {count} new people. Send links only after they reply.

similar_openers.title: Same first message to many
similar_openers.body: Sent almost the same first message to {count} people. Write each first message yourself.

night_starts.title: New chats at night
night_starts.body: Messaged {count} new people after {late} or before {early}. Message new people in working hours.

failed_sends.title: Messages not delivered
failed_sends.body: {count} messages to phone numbers could not be delivered. Check the number before sending.

waiting.title: Customers waiting
waiting.body: {count} customers wrote in the last day and are waiting for {name} to answer. Answer them before starting new chats.

number_at_limit.title: Number at its daily limit
number_at_limit.body: This phone number has reached {count} new chats today (limit {limit}). Use it only for replies until tomorrow.

number_near_limit.title: Number close to its daily limit
number_near_limit.body: This phone number has made {count} of its {limit} new chats today. Keep the rest for people who expect you.

number_over_limit_days.title: Number went over its limit before
number_over_limit_days.body: This phone number reached its daily limit of {limit} on {days, plural, =1 {# day} other {# days}}. Share new chats with other numbers.

number_warming_up.title: New number
number_warming_up.body: This phone number is new (connected {days, plural, =0 {today} =1 {# day ago} other {# days ago}}). Keep it to {limit} new chats a day for the first two weeks.

number_disconnected.title: Number disconnected
number_disconnected.body: This phone number is disconnected. Ask an admin to reconnect it.

number_reply_rate_low.title: Few people write back to this number
number_reply_rate_low.body: Only {replied} of {total} people messaged first from this phone number wrote back. Slow down on new chats from it.

number_reply_rate_close.title: Replies close to the minimum
number_reply_rate_close.body: Replies to this phone number are only just above the minimum ({rate}%, minimum {min}%). Slow down on new chats from it.

number_safety_low.title: {rating, select, 1 {Low safety rating} other {Safety rating slipping}}
number_safety_low.body: {rating, select, 1 {WhatsApp rates this number "Use caution". Cut new chats in half this week.} other {WhatsApp rates this number "Needs attention". Message fewer new people from it this week.}}

waiting_unassigned.title: Customers waiting with nobody on it
waiting_unassigned.body: {count} customers wrote in the last day and nobody is handling their chat. Give each one to someone.

auto_review.title: Automatic messages need a review
auto_review.body: {who, select, bot {The AI assistant} other {Automatic notifications (Compass / API)}} started {count} chats with a {rate}% reply rate and sent links first. Ask the owner to review those messages.

auto_low_reply.title: Few replies to automatic messages
auto_low_reply.body: {who, select, bot {The AI assistant} other {Automatic notifications (Compass / API)}} started {count} chats with a {rate}% reply rate. Ask the owner to review those messages.

auto_links_first.title: Links in automatic first messages
auto_links_first.body: {who, select, bot {The AI assistant} other {Automatic notifications (Compass / API)}} sent a link in the first message to {count} people. Ask the owner to review those messages.

auto_chasing.title: Automatic messages without an answer
auto_chasing.body: {who, select, bot {The AI assistant} other {Automatic notifications (Compass / API)}} kept messaging {count} people who did not answer. Ask the owner to review those messages.

advice.reply_rate_low: Message only people who expect you.
advice.over_limit_days: Spread new chats across the week.
advice.burst: Wait a minute or two between new chats.
advice.chase_new: Stop messaging people who don't answer.
advice.links_first: Send links only after people reply.
advice.night_starts: Message new people in working hours.

guard.limitReached: You have messaged {started} new people today — your daily limit is {limit}. No more new chats today; answer the open ones.
guard.limitReachedBlocked: You have reached today's limit of {limit} new people. A message to someone new will not be sent; replies to existing chats still go out.
guard.limitNear: You have messaged {started} of your {limit} new people for today. Keep the rest for people who expect to hear from you.
guard.numberLimit: This phone number has reached {started} new chats today (limit {limit}). Use it only for replies until tomorrow.
guard.numberLimitBlocked: This phone number has reached its limit of {limit} new chats today. A message to someone new will not be sent until tomorrow.
guard.unanswered: This contact has not answered your last {count} messages. Wait for a reply before sending more.
guard.newContactTip: This is your first message to this person. Say who you are, write it yourself, and send links only after they reply.

desc.assistant: Your AI provider, key and models, and what the assistant knows about your business.
desc.auto-reply: When the bot answers customers on its own, and when it hands over to a person.
desc.knowledge: Documents the AI answers from, and how strictly it sticks to them.

AiAgents.assistantOn: AI assistant on — needed for inbox drafts and auto-reply
AiAgents.modelsDesc: Use a cheaper model for simple messages and a stronger one for hard ones.
AiAgents.assistantFirst: Turn on the AI assistant first (Assistant tab).

replyOn.title: Reply on
replyOn.all: Every number — the one the customer wrote to
replyOn.allDesc: Whapi or Cloud API, the bot answers on the number the customer used. A chat pinned to another number is left to people.
replyOn.onlyDesc: The bot answers only on this number; chats on other numbers are left to people.
replyOn.lockHint: Saving will lock the AI to this number only
replyOn.whenOff: Takes effect when auto-reply is on

AiAgents.needsEmbeddingsKey: Only applies with an embeddings key.
AiAgents.title: AI Agents
AiAgents.description: Your bring-your-own-key AI agent — set it up, then test it in the playground before it replies to customers in the inbox.

overview.desc: What the AI is doing right now. Change any part on its tab.
overview.defaultAndOthers: The default number ({name}) and others of its type
overview.defaultAndOthersUnnamed: The default number and others of its type
overview.partnerBanks: {count, plural, =0 {No partner banks} one {# partner bank} other {# partner banks}}
overview.documents: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
